setup.subtitle: Chat with AI using your own computer, or team up with others to run bigger models
setup.auto_download_hint: Automatically download pieces of popular AI models so the network can run them. Uses some disk space but helps everyone.
setup.resource_hint: Let others use some of your computer's power to help run AI. You earn credits in return.
setup.cloud_hint: Connect an AI service like OpenAI or DeepSeek to start chatting right away. Most offer free tiers.
chat.empty_hint: Pick a model from the dropdown above and start chatting

chat.no_response: No response received. The model might still be loading — wait a moment and try again.
chat.connection_failed: Connection failed — check that the server is running and try again.

stats.credits_help: Earned by helping others, spent when you use the network

stats.served_help: Requests your computer handled for others (earns credits)

compare.title: Model Compare

compare.pick_models: Pick 2 or more models to compare
settings.title: Settings
settings.access_token_hint: Your private key for connecting other apps to SwarmLLM. Keep it secret.
settings.auto_download_hint: Downloads pieces of AI models so the network can run them. Uses disk space.
errors.server_unreachable: Can't reach SwarmLLM — is it running?
